name: gizza-ai/gps-location-remover
summary: Remove only the GPS location tags from a photo, keeping camera data

tool.description: Remove ONLY the GPS/geolocation tags (latitude, longitude, altitude, GPS timestamp, etc.) from a JPEG or PNG photo, while KEEPING all other EXIF metadata — camera make/model, lens, and exposure settings (ISO, aperture, shutter speed, timestamps). Unlike a strip-all-metadata cleaner, camera and exposure data survive. The pixels are NOT re-encoded, so there is no quality loss. Useful for privacy before sharing photos while keeping the technical camera data. Provide the image as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). JPEG and PNG only; GPS embedded in XMP is not removed.

url.description: Image URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.
